description:
Shelvr is a home for everything you save for later. Capture links, photos and quick notes. Shelvr reads each save, adds a title, summary and tags, and suggests Spaces where it belongs. You choose what to keep in each collection.

Bring bookmarks, screenshots and scattered notes into one searchable library.

SAVE IN ONE PLACE
• Paste a link, write a note, or import a photo
• Save from other apps with the iOS share sheet
• Keep articles, recipes, screenshots and ideas together

LET AI HELP YOU ORGANIZE
• Get suggested titles, summaries and tags
• Read extracted articles in a focused reader when available
• Create Spaces for themes such as Design or Recipes
• Review matching suggestions and choose what to add

FIND WHAT YOU SAVED
• Search your saved content
• Browse your feed and Spaces
• See saved photos with location information on a map

TIDY YOUR CAMERA ROLL
• Swipe through photos to keep, delete, or save them to Shelvr
• Review photos before confirming deletions

Shelvr Pro is required to create new saves and use Pro features. Pro includes unlimited links and notes, and storage for up to 1,000 photos. Existing saves remain available in read-only mode if Pro expires.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled. Prices, billing periods and any available trial terms are shown before purchase. Restore purchases or manage your subscription from Profile or Apple ID settings.

Privacy: https://shelvr-web.vercel.app/privacy
Terms: https://shelvr-web.vercel.app/terms
promotionalText: Keep links, notes and photos together. Shelvr adds titles and tags, suggests Spaces, and helps you find what you saved.
whatsNew:
What’s new in Shelvr:
• Notes now have their own page, and you can edit a note’s title and text right where you read it.
• Import links in bulk, including your X bookmarks: Profile > Import from X.
• Shelvr now speaks French, German, Spanish, Japanese, Korean and Brazilian Portuguese.
• Bug fixes and reliability improvements.
